description: This file defines the GccMapReader class, which is a utility for parsing and printing information from GCC linked .map files. It processes the map file to extract sections related to '.bss' segments, handles both single-line and multi-line entries, and outputs sorted records with their sizes and names.

classes.name: GccMapReader
classes.description: A utility class for reading and processing GCC map files, extracting segment information, and outputting sorted data related to '.bss' sections.

classes.name: Record
classes.description: An inner class representing a memory record with size and name, used to hold parsed segment information.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program; reads a map file, processes it, sorts records, and outputs the data with total size.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes lines from the map file to extract records related to '.bss' sections.

methods.name: parseMultiLine
methods.description: Parses multi-line entries in the map file that describe section sizes and names.

methods.name: parseSingleLine
methods.description: Parses single-line entries in the map file that describe section sizes and names.

methods.name: debug
methods.description: A debug method that is currently commented out; used for printing debug information.
